name: Club Sapphire
source:
Club Sapphire, where smiles shine bright! Become Annamoriah Parker and see what it's like to work with the cutest hostesses the night club scene has to offer!

Experience what it's like to be an up-and-coming hostess in this premier Visual Novel! Be yourself and use your own choices to make new friends with the colorful cast of characters, ranging from star struck dreamer Zara to stoic goth girl Kitty. Embark on a journey of personal growth and heartfelt connections as you guide these extraordinary girls to unlock their full potential within the club, and maybe even find Annamoriah's true love. 

No matter what you decide as Annamoriah, she'll find what she's always wanted during her exciting journey from everyday ordinary to the best hostess Noelle Beach has to offer!

[From [url=https://team-dragon-made.itch.io/club-sapphire-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
蓝宝石俱乐部，笑容灿烂！成为Annamoriah Parker，看看与夜总会场景中最可爱的女主人一起工作是什么感觉！

在这部一流的视觉小说中体验成为一名崭露头角的女主人的感觉！做你自己，用你自己的选择与丰富多彩的角色结交新朋友，从明星梦想家Zara到坚忍的哥特女孩Kitty。踏上个人成长和真诚联系的旅程，引导这些非凡的女孩在俱乐部中释放她们的全部潜力，甚至可能找到安娜莫里亚的真爱。

无论你作为Annamoriah做出什么决定，她都会在从平凡的平凡到诺埃尔海滩最好的女主人的激动人心的旅程中找到她一直想要的东西！

[来自[url=https://team-dragon-made.itch.io/club-sapphire-demo]itch.io[/url]]
